thread:
sarah: CI red on docker-push job for PR #6123 — push times out during blob upload after my Dockerfile tweak. job link: https://ci.internal/runs/98765
matt: which step fails? can you paste the error? :eyes:
ci-bot: build-6123 (docker-push) failed — https://ci.internal/runs/98765 — exit_code=28
sarah: here's the tail from the job:
```
uploading layer 45/60: POST https://registry.redwood-infra.com/v2/myorg/myimage/blobs/uploads/: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
ERROR: failed to push to registry: EOF
```
olga: net/http TLS handshake timeout usually network or registry flakiness. Is this only on the dedicated runner or all runners?
sarah: only on linux-runner-12 and it consistently times out after ~2m. rerun sometimes passes though (very flaky).
matt: could be token rotation causing auth renegotiate. can you curl registry from the runner? `curl -v -I https://registry.redwood-infra.com/v2/`
sarah: ran that from the runner:
```
* Connected to registry.redwood-infra.com (10.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake completed in 1.9s
> GET /v2/ HTTP/1.1
> Host: registry.redwood-infra.com
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
ashley: also saw a similar timeout after the Dockerfile change that added a big COPY of precompiled deps — that increased layer upload time. registry has a 120s idle handshake window for chunked uploads.
jordan: can you try `docker build --no-cache` and push with `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` to reduce parallelism? also try `docker push --disable-content-trust` (if signed) just to isolate.
sarah: re-run with no-cache + single concurrent upload now. will report back.
ci-bot: rerun started by sarah — build-6123 (docker-push) #2
sarah: same timeout but later in the stream, now at layer 48/60. logs show chunked upload then TLS timeout.
```
POST /v2/myorg/myimage/blobs/uploads/?digest=sha256:... HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
-- chunked trailer --
* TLS handshake timeout
```
matt: registry-side, check ingress logs for long-lived idle connections around 10.2.3.4 and any 502/timeout from backend. olga any chance GC was running? that can spike latency.
olga: checking — no GC at that time, but there was an auth-provider rollout 10 mins earlier (token issuer). looking at logs: several 401->200 refresh cycles seen from runners; might correlate.
ashley: temporary mitigation: split the big layer (move precompiled deps to separate smaller layers) or enable client-side compression to reduce upload size/time.
jordan: I'm happy to bisect the PR — will run a sequence of builds with previous Dockerfile + incremental changes to find the exact line that pushed layer size over the threshold. I'll start with commit abc123 -> abd124.
sarah: thanks. can someone from infra also probe registry timeouts? matt, olga — can you open a quick issue and pin any 5xx/timeout spikes to this timeframe? tag: priority-high
matt: creating infra issue now and attaching runner logs + registry ingress sample. #infra-987
devops-bot: Created issue INFRA-987: "Registry TLS handshake timeouts during docker-push from linux-runner-12" — assigned to matt, olga
sarah: plan: jordan will bisect PR to isolate Dockerfile change; infra (matt/olga) will triage registry/issuer logs; sarah will split big COPY as a short-term workaround and re-run. everyone OK?
ashley: ok from my side. :thumbsup:
jordan: starting bisect run, will post updates in this thread. estimated 30–45m.
sarah: thanks all — if bisect shows it's layer size, we'll ship a small follow-up to avoid giant layers and avoid retry storms. ping me if you need access to the runner.
